about: flagship/security-notice/v1 (docs/security-notices.md). canonical: the exact signed string. positive: notices that parse and verify under keys.authorityPubHex. reject: notices that must not be accepted, with the reason (malformed = fails the rules before any signature check; signature-invalid; unauthorized-signer). unsignable: bodies that break a rule, so no canonical string exists (code = the first rule broken, checked in the order the spec lists). outcomes: what a verified notice shows for a client at a clock (none/banner/lock). accept: how a stored state absorbs a fetched candidate (anti-rollback, fail open); expect.seq is the seq of the notice kept, or null. Seeds are raw Ed25519 seeds. All times are epoch ms; T0 = 1792000000000.
